all saints blessed are the clean of heart, for they shall see god. blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of god. all saints today’s feast is an occasion for great thanksgiving, honouring all the saints, both known and unknown, who offer us memories and models of holiness. we, too, are called to holiness; to be saints. the communion of saints prays for us, willing us on to join them. we can try to do this by following the message and example of jesus, as portrayed in today’s gospel. here jesus teaches the disciples god’s law in a new way. his values and attitudes, summed up in the beatitudes, are a map comprised of eight differen t paths. by following them, we align our lives with the heart of god and ‘holiness’. november prayer & rosary clonaghadoo cemetery : there will be rosary in clonaghadoo cemetery after 9am mass this sunday morning november 1st. st. joseph’s cemetery, acragar you are invited to our cemetery prayers and rosary next sunday november 8th at 2.00pm. in st. joseph’s cemetery. synod news - synodality news over 300 national synodal assembly delegates from across ireland met two weeks ago(oct 17th) to consider 35 proposals to guide the future of the catholic church in ireland. these 35 proposals were subsequently grouped under five pathways: – the church that proclaims the gospel – the church as a community of belonging – the church as a place of healing – the church that accompanies – the church that empowers for ministry and co-responsibility. the various recommendations of the delegates will now be shared with our catholic bishops for their consideration. more on

november 2nd all souls day on the feast of all souls, and throughout the entire month of november, we recall our deceased relatives, friends, and all the faithful departed. we pray for them, remembering that likewise they will intercede us too. eternal rest grant unto them o lord, may perpetual light shine on them. may they rest in peace. mass for all souls will be at 10.00am and 7.30pm on monday (2nd) all saints day prayer dear holy saints of god, we join our prayers of praise to yours this day, with you we sing of god’s goodness, rejoice in god’s mercy and celebrate gods incredible love. teach us to live as you lived – always thinking of others, always recognising our weaknesses, always rejoicing in god’s gifts, always closely following jesus. blessed are you, happy are you, all you holy saints of god. pray for us that we, too, may someday be among god’s holy ones. amen. in november we remembe r: as we remember in a particular way in november those who have died, you are invited to follow the daily scripture posts from the diocese of kildare and leighlin on the'kandle' facebook and xaccounts, as well as prayers for particular days. a prayer leaflet is also available on
